title: Package the headless node as an installable system service
author: w0F5vYijNonu8kkqLSa_jYY4GIV-Q5HpbxYY525ggm4

events.title: Package the headless node as an installable system service
events.body:
## Outcome

Provide a reproducible, non-interactive service install that can be monitored, stopped cleanly, backed up, restored, and verified before use.

## Implementation

- Add a checked-in service-manager unit template plus install, uninstall, start, stop, and status commands around existing headless mode.
- Run as an unprivileged account with explicit configuration, identity, mirror, and log directories.
- Add a health command that verifies process state, relay connectivity, and readability of configured mirrors.
- Implement graceful shutdown with a bounded timeout and clear recovery after an unclean stop.
- Add a cold-backup manifest with relative paths, sizes, and checksums plus restore validation into an empty target directory.

## Acceptance criteria

- Runtime requires no display server and does not run as root.
- Mutable data lives only in documented directories.
- Backup output never prints key material and detects checksum mismatch.
- Restore rejects unsafe permissions, corrupt manifests, and non-empty targets.
- CI installs the service in a temporary root, starts a fixture node, checks health, stops it, restores a backup, and reads the restored mirror.

## Dependencies

None.

## Verification

Run install/uninstall idempotency, unprivileged execution, health, graceful and forced stop, backup consistency, corrupt restore, and restored-mirror tests.
